header.title: Value and value index of retail sales by type of retail outlet
tablenote: Average index from October 2019 – September 2020 = 100   The value index measures the changes in value terms in a particular period as compared with a reference period, while the volume index is derived from the value index of retail sales by adjusting for price changes.   The above statistics are compiled based on the Hong Kong Standard Industrial Classification (HSIC) Version 2.0. Users may also download past statistics based on HSIC Version 1.1 for reference.   Figures may not add up to the total due to rounding.
The figures for ‘Supermarkets’ above do not include retail sales in supermarket sections of department stores. Supplementary statistics that include such sales are presented above for reference.
[φ3] Figure denotes increase or decrease of less than 0.05%.
header.source: Distribution Services Statistics Section, Census and Statistics Department (Enquiry telephone no. : 3903 7400  Enquiry e-mail : mrs@censtatd.gov.hk)
